label: Quotient Analytics saved-report screen
description: The Quotient Analytics SAVED REPORT screen, in the real product design language: white card with a 'Saved Report' badge + report title, date-range chip and Refresh/Share buttons; a KPI column whose values COUNT UP with green delta pills; a hero trend chart whose line DRAWS itself left-to-right (area fades in under it); and a 'By channel' breakdown whose bars FILL. The entrance IS the performance -- cast it wherever the story says 'see the whole picture' or 'the agent built a report'. Works standalone, or docked into quotient-app-shell's content region (docked: true) so the agent panel narrates beside it. PERFORMABLE surface (cursor verbs via script).

kpis.label: KPI column: [{label, value: number (counts up), display?: final text override e.g. '128K', delta?: '+38%' (leading - renders red)}] -- 3 fit best

chart.label: Hero trend: {title, points: [numbers -- the line draws through them], labels: [x-axis labels]}

script.label: Optional cursor actions (move-cursor, click, wait) -- the entrance choreography runs regardless

docked.label: true = merge into quotient-app-shell's white content card (strips the window border/shadow). Position over the shell's content-card box.
